limitations: Research-only estimates for the original four-operation scoping template.
No causal per-brick prices or independent coefficient identification is established.
Metered quality-rejected completions retain their incurred token consumption.
No sequential handoffs, tools, retries, or new execution versions were measured.
Winning training-CV error is not an unbiased new-test estimate.
API rating and marketplace selling prices are not token prediction targets.

execution_policy.inputs: Only the six paraphrased public-request summaries, requirement annotations, exclusions, and scoping template.
execution_policy.quality: Automatic contract checks are necessary but not sufficient. Free-text drafts require human review before quality-preserving optimization can be promoted.
execution_policy.retries: None. Stop after transport, telemetry, output-cap, or identity failure; preserve uncertain reservations.
execution_policy.tools: None. No source fetch, private data, client contact, deployment, or full-project execution.

support.interpretation: Marginal ranges and observed combinations are not joint/domain support.
